summary.text: Dave Jacoby, a Democrat, represents District 86 in the Iowa House of Representatives; the Iowa Legislature's biography, which lists Jacoby as David Jacoby, lists Jacoby as serving a twelfth term.

paragraphs.text: The biography describes Jacoby as a retired STEM outreach coordinator at the University of Iowa who served two terms on the Coralville City Council and eight years on the Iowa Workforce Development Board.
It lists a B.A. from the University of Northern Iowa and says Jacoby was born in 1956 in Cedar Rapids and lives in Coralville.
